name: Fern & Field
heroBody: Healthy houseplants, potted and ready, sent in packaging that keeps them upright. Each one comes with a care card written by the person who grew it.
heroAlt: A monstera plant against a terracotta wall
gridTitle: Plants and the things they need

perks.title: Potted and ready
perks.body: No repotting needed for a year.

perks.title: Care card included
perks.body: Light, water and what to watch for.

shipping: Ships Monday to Wednesday so plants never sit in a depot over a weekend

closing.title: Not sure where to start?
closing.body: The snake plant forgives almost anything: low light, missed waterings, a dry flat. It is the plant we give to people who say they kill plants.

products.name: Monstera Deliciosa Houseplant in Terracotta Pot
products.blurb: Split leaves, fast growing, bright indirect light.
products.description: A Monstera deliciosa houseplant, about 45 cm tall, with its first split leaves, in a 15 cm terracotta pot.

products.name: Snake Plant Laurentii Houseplant
products.blurb: Upright striped leaves. Thrives on neglect.
products.description: A snake plant (Sansevieria laurentii) houseplant with yellow-edged upright leaves, about 40 cm tall. Tolerates low light and missed waterings.
features: Water every two to three weeks

products.name: Marble Queen Pothos Houseplant in White Pot
products.description: A Marble Queen pothos houseplant with cream-marbled trailing leaves, in a white ceramic pot. Happy on a shelf or in a hanger.

products.name: Echeveria Succulent in Mint Ceramic Pot
products.blurb: A rosette for a sunny windowsill.
products.description: An echeveria succulent in a mint-green ceramic pot, 10 cm across. Needs a sunny windowsill and very little water.

products.name: Yellow Steel Watering Can, 1.5 Litre
products.blurb: Long spout for getting under the leaves.
products.description: A powder-coated yellow steel watering can with a long narrow spout, 1.5 litre. Made for indoor plants.
